# Achieve: Why More Families Are Choosing Online Learning


- November 16, 2024


Niyoka McCoy, Chief Learning Officer at Stride, Inc., highlights virtual pre-k as an accessible alternative to traditional classrooms. Combining engaging instruction, hands-on activities, and flexibility, these programs help families overcome barriers like high costs and long commutes while providing young learners with essential early education benefits and opportunities for growth.


[Read the full article on New Pittsburgh Courier here](https://newpittsburghcourier.com/2024/11/16/achieve-why-more-families-are-choosing-online-learning/) .
